name: standupcomedynyc
description: standupcomedynyc.com: a curated, dated shortlist of NYC stand-up shows, recurring rooms, open mics and clubs.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -R web/. dist/ && cp robots.txt sitemap.xml dist/ && node scripts/markdown.js --out=dist
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run build
